violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress (26 TAC §747.2309(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress
violation_type.typical_finding: Crib used by an infant was observed two have two standard mattresses and one thin mattress.       Note: One standard mattress and the thin mattress were removed from crib during inspection.

finding_variants.text: Crib used by an infant was observed two have two standard mattresses and one thin mattress.       Note: One standard mattress and the thin mattress were removed from crib during inspection.

There was a four month old infant in the play yard with a mattress pad not specific to the crib model and smaller than the surface of the play yard. This was corrected at inspection when the mattress was removed.

9 month old infant was found laying in a bed covered in a blanket. The infant was awake at this time. There were also many other blankets and pillows all around the bed.     Note: Infant was removed immediately.
There was an infant asleep during naptime in a pack and play with a supplemental mattress.
Two mattresses were observed in the infant crib.    Note: Pictures were taken.
The operation did not have a snug fitting mattress for one crib.
